elements.element: The Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The Servicer must maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence throughout the Agreement term.

elements.element: The Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: The Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If the Vendor processes Customer Data, the Vendor must maintain cyber/privacy insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: The Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
